name: Vidyajyothi Scheme- Financial Aid For Uniforms And Study Materials To PH Students
benefit:
Financial assistance is being provided to students whose disability percentage is 40% or above for the purchase of study materials and uniforms on the following basis:
**Sl. No.****Course/Class****Assistance for Study materials****Assistance for Uniform**19th to 10th Standard@ ₹1000/- each (50 children from each district)@ ₹1500/- (30 children from each district)2+1, +2, ITI, Polytechnic, VHSC@ ₹2
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Kerala.
1. The applicant should be a student.
1. The applicant should be studying in Government / Aided Institution in Kerala.
1. The financial assistance will be given to the students who are studying in Class 9th to Post-Graduation.
1. The applicant who has 40% or more disability is eligible to apply under the scheme.
1. The applicant’s annual family income is not applicable under this scheme.

**Note:** The preference will be given to the students of Below Poverty Line (BPL) category.
